overall: Atlanta is running warm this morning with the current temp at 80.6°F as of 11:00 ET and a strong warming velocity of +1.8°F/hr, suggesting active daytime heating is well underway. max_temp_prediction: With 80.6°F already locked in at 11 AM and roughly 4–5 hours of heating remaining until the typical afternoon peak, sustaining even a modestly slower warming rate of ~1.3–1.5°F/hr would push the high into the 86–88°F range. Confidence is moderate — best estimate is the 87–88°F zone, with the primary downside risk being an early afternoon convective event.
